semantic_policy.hard_activation: Only narrow context-complete relation phrases in the visual-obligation registry create hard duties. Broad labels such as cafe aesthetic, alley mood, exhibition vibe, rooftop mood, station aesthetic, industrial aesthetic, or hanok aesthetic remain candidate-only.
semantic_policy.visual_actuation: A selected emotional-place relation must remain an observable same-frame structure: physical place anchor, human or object action, depth or source geometry, and an immediate material or state consequence. A location label, color grade, bokeh, costume, or generic mood alone is never evidence.
semantic_policy.claim_boundary: Pixels may support only visible architecture, path continuity, surface state, light ownership, viewing or browsing direction, transit state, retained material junctions, and inside-outside topology. They do not establish identity, ethnicity, nationality, social class, ownership, relationship, authenticity, historicity, destination, or personal memory.
semantic_policy.reference_boundary: A supplied portrait may guide only observable adult appearance, face proportions, hair, wardrobe, and framing. It never supplies identity, protected traits, personal history, cultural membership, or a place connection.
semantic_policy.judgment_boundary: Registry, routing, prompt, and request audits prove only data binding. A rendered arm passes only when all five profile gates are simultaneously visible; partial visibility is failure, and requesting-user judgment remains separate.

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: A physical window aperture, near seat or table, contacting small hand action, directional window-to-room gradient, and visible progress trace coexist in one frame.
A thick physical boundary joins readable near and far zones through coherent occlusion, a crossing or pause action, and one continuous floor or path.
An uninterrupted walkable surface, edge rhythm, three depth positions, grounded mid-action, and a wayfinding anchor make movement through place legible.
A visibly wet surface receives a geometrically aligned reflection from an in-frame owner, with an occluding interruption and a wet-dry boundary.
A near elevated plane ends at a visible physical edge above a lower distant vista, with several depth cues and a view-oriented action.
A physically mounted artwork, viewer body and gaze orientation, clear sightline, credible viewing distance, and continuing gallery route coexist.
Repeated inventory, a partly removed item linked to its source slot, hand contact, aligned attention, and the resulting display gap show selection in progress.
A transit system boundary, visible vehicle state, anchored waiting or boarding action, path-aligned orientation, and immediate readiness consequence share the frame.
A retained industrial process or shell remnant physically joins a new public use, retaining wear while a current action follows the old circulation.
A bounded madang, raised timber maru, eaves-column junction, room-to-courtyard sightline, and small daily transition action make hanok topology visible.
